description: File d'attente des installations de production d'énergies renouvelables en attente de raccordement sur le réseau SRD - par filière is a dataset listed in SRD OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SRD. Ce jeu de données est lié à la visualisation suivante: Visualisation - File d'attente des installations de production d'énergies renouvelables en attente de raccordement sur le réseau SRD - par filière File d'attente des installations de production d'énergies renouvelables en attente de raccordement sur le réseau SRD Attention: ce jeu de données est publié trimestriellement ... Coverage: Vienne (SRD electricity network). The portal files it under Production et stockage. Its keywords are File d'attente. The portal shows 18 records. The portal shows 2025-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte version 2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-srd-energies-fr-portal.
